subject: Hotspike mitigation commitments & action plan
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodai.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir@lensai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodai.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodai.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 09:15:00 +0000
Subject: Hotspike mitigation commitments & action plan

Hi Samir —

Thanks again for the quick sync earlier. I wanted to follow up with a concise summary of what happened this morning and the customer-facing commitments were making while we finish the deeper post‑incident analysis.

What happened (short):
- At ~07:42 UTC a rapid, high-cardinality traffic spike targeted a small subset of dedicated GPU tenants using the 8xA100 pool. The surge triggered our circuit‑breaking logic and a temporary autoscaler backoff that caused request rejections and elevated latencies for some LensAI requests for ~22 minutes.

Immediate mitigations we applied (completed):
- Burstable standby capacity enabled and selected traffic routed to the warm standby pool (07:48 UTC).
- Temporarily relaxed the autoscaler threshold (07:50 UTC) to prevent aggressive backoff on short-lived spikes.
- Enabled a short lived, per-tenant buffer for LensAI to prevent retry amplification.

Customer commitments were delivering today:
- Formal incident timeline & raw metrics (attached: hotspike-timeline.csv).
- Draft runbook changes to avoid recurrence (attached: runbook-dedicated-v1.pdf).
- One-off usage credit to cover impacted requests on 2027-05-28 (were proposing 10% credit; see attached credit-offer-draft.eml).
- 4-week elevated monitoring for LensAI with daily health checks and a weekly sync.

Next steps (internal):
- Connor: confirm standby capacity cost and activation window for billing.
- Rishi: short RCA + quantification of why circuit-breaker hit before autoscaler scaled.
- Marissa: coordinate the credit issuance and PR to billing/finance.

Ill send a consolidated note to Ops & Product after I hear back from the three of you. Samir — if this matches what you expect, Ill lock the credit and schedule the weekly check-ins.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Customer Reliability Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: hotspike-timeline.csv (csv), runbook-dedicated-v1.pdf (pdf), credit-offer-draft.eml (eml)

Subject: Re: Fwd: Hotspike mitigation commitments & action plan

Quick technical notes / provisional RCA: 

- Root cause: the spike pattern was high concurrency with many short-lived sessions. Our circuit-breaker checks per-tenant queue depth at 100ms intervals. The autoscaler evaluates aggregated GPU utilization over 30s windows; the spike peaked and decayed inside that window so the autoscaler didnt scale aggressively. In short: detection mismatch between CB (fast) and autoscaler (slow).

- Mitigations planned:
  * Short-term (completed): relax autoscaler backoff, route to standby (already done).
  * Near-term (patch in 7 days): introduce a fast-path spike detector that triggers a temporary, small-scale proactive spin-up (10–20% extra capacity) when we detect >X concurrency delta inside 10s.
  * Mid-term (30–45 days): tune circuit-breaker thresholds and add per-request token backpressure signals to reduce retry amplification.

- Quantification (preliminary numbers): LensAI saw ~3.6% of requests dropped and ~7.1% of requests returned with latency >2s during the 07:42–08:05 window. Im attaching the metric slices in the timeline CSV. Will follow up with final numbers after one more sanity run across the datastore.

Ill post the branch & patch PR today and will ping QA for a limited rollout to staging by May 31.

—Rishi
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference

Subject: Follow-up: commitments, credits, and 4-week monitoring plan

Hi Samir —

Thanks for reviewing the timeline and for the quick questions earlier. Per our internal confirmations: 

- Credit: Redwood will apply a 10% service credit to LensAI's May 28 usage invoice to cover impacted requests. Marissa has created the credit request to Finance; you should see the credit applied within 5 business days.
- Cost to standby: Redwood will absorb the incremental cost for the standby routing for this event; LensAI will not see extra per-token charges for the reroute.
- Technical fix ETA: Rishi plans to ship the spike-detector patch to staging by 2027-05-31 and to production by 2027-06-07, followed by tuned CB thresholds in the 30–45 day window.

What were doing for the next 4 weeks:
- Daily signal checks (automated) for your tenant with an assigned SRE point of contact.
- Weekly 30-minute status sync (your preferred time) to review metrics and any anomalies.
- Postmortem write-up published to the status page with final RCA and mitigations (link below).

If youd like to take the 30-minute slot this week, were available 16:00–16:30 UTC today. Otherwise Ill assume email is fine and will publish the final postmortem next week.

Link to incident page: https://status.redwood.com/incident/INC-20270528-hotspike

Appreciate your patience — we want to make sure LensAI has the predictability you need as you scale.

Best regards,
Laura Bennett
Customer Reliability Manager
Redwood Inference
